xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4501: Diff panel: conversation 'vs main' falls through to the turn route, whole-conversation views have no file list, and agent 'vs main' hardcodes main

plan.title: Diff panel: conversation 'vs main' falls through to the turn route, whole-conversation views have no file list, and agent 'vs main' hardcodes main
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The conversation 'vs main' chip requests /diffs/vs-main, which has no route and falls through to /diffs/:turnId (conversation start vs working tree). Whole-conversation responses (/full and the fallthrough) carry no files, so the file picker is empty. A conversation with no edit turns shows 'No completed turns yet' even when its repository changed. The agent vs-main view hardcodes main...HEAD and ignores the configured default branch.
narratives.Proposal: Add a default-branch resolver (repo default_branch, then workspace.default_branch, then main; never pr_target) and a shared diffVsDefaultBranch helper (three-dot <baseRef>...HEAD, local branch before origin, missing base = baseRef null + empty files). Use it from the agent vs-main route and a new conversation /diffs/vs-main route (in a new routes/conversation-diffs.ts file, since routes/conversations.ts is at its size cap). Make /diffs/full return files and honor ?file=. Remove the DiffPanel 'No completed turns yet' guard. Document the semantics.
narratives.NonGoals:
- An arbitrary two-ref compare or whitespace toggle (PAN-3178)
- Including uncommitted working-tree changes in 'vs main'
- Relabeling the 'vs main' chip with the real branch name
- Showing untracked (never-added) files in any diff view
- Multi-repository 'vs main' for a conversation (cwd repository only)
- A new button to open the diff panel for a conversation with no edit turns
- Changing getRepoTargetBranch or PR-sync behavior
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row

autoDecisions.summary: 'vs main' keeps three-dot <baseRef>...HEAD semantics (committed changes only) for both agents and conversations.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's rollout note accepts an empty view when HEAD is an ancestor of the default branch, and the two-ref compare is tracked on PAN-3178; one helper with one meaning avoids two definitions of 'vs main'.

autoDecisions.summary: Default branch = matching workspace.repos[].default_branch, then workspace.default_branch, then 'main'; pr_target is ignored.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says 'configured default branch'; pr_target names a PR target, not the branch a repository is compared with. The 'main' fallback matches every other default-branch caller in src/lib.

autoDecisions.summary: Resolve the base ref local branch first, then origin/<branch>; a missing ref returns 200 with baseRef null and files [].
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's fixture is a local repo with no remote, so local-first is required; a 200 empty result degrades to the panel's empty-list state instead of 'Failed to fetch diff'.

autoDecisions.summary: The conversation repository is git rev-parse --show-toplevel of conv.cwd, and conv.projectKey overrides cwd-based project lookup.
autoDecisions.rationale: The existing existsSync(cwd/.git) check misses a cwd in a subdirectory; projectKey is the operator's explicit project assignment (PAN-1577).

autoDecisions.summary: Remove the 'No completed turns yet' guard for every DiffPanel, agents included.
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest change that makes All turns work with zero summaries; for agents with fewer than two checkpoints /full already returns files [], so the only visible change is 'No changed files in this selection.'

autoDecisions.summary: Move the conversation diff routes into a new routes/conversation-diffs.ts before adding the vs-main route.
autoDecisions.rationale: routes/conversations.ts is 1072 lines at its 1072-line allowlist cap; agents may not raise caps, and conversation-subagent-input.ts is the precedent for split route files.

items.title: Add defaultBranchForRepo and resolveDefaultBranchForRepo to project-repos

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-1 exactly: add the pure defaultBranchForRepo(project, repoRoot) (matching workspace.repos[] entry by trailing path segment, then workspace.default_branch, then main; pr_target ignored) and resolveDefaultBranchForRepo(repoRoot, projectKey?) (getProjectSync(projectKey) first, then findProjectByPath(repoRoot)) to src/lib/project-repos.ts, and add the listed unit tests to tests/lib/project-repos.test.ts, extending its existing projects.js mock with findProjectByPath.

items.title: Given a project with workspace.default_branch "trunk" and pr_target "release", defaultBranchForRepo returns "trunk".

Given a workspace.repos[] entry with path "frontend" and default_branch "develop", defaultBranchForRepo returns "develop" for root /p/workspaces/feature-x/frontend and the workspace default for /p/backend.
Given no project, defaultBranchForRepo falls back to "main".
When getProjectSync(projectKey) returns null, resolveDefaultBranchForRepo falls back to findProjectByPath(repoRoot).
Add base-parameterized diffAgainstBase helpers and resolveBaseRef to checkpoint-manager

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-2: in checkpoint-manager.ts add diffAgainstBase(cwd, baseRef, filePath?) and diffAgainstBaseFiles(cwd, baseRef) (same bodies as diffAgainstMain/diffAgainstMainFiles but with `${baseRef}...HEAD`) and resolveBaseRef(cwd, branch) (local branch first, then origin/<branch>, else null). Leave diffAgainstMain/diffAgainstMainFiles in place; agent-vs-main-route deletes them. Add a fixture-repo test (default branch trunk via git symbolic-ref before the first commit, no remote).

items.title: Given a fixture repo with default branch trunk and no remote, resolveBaseRef(repo, "trunk") returns "trunk" and resolveBaseRef(repo, "main") returns null.
Given HEAD on a feature branch with one modified and one added file, diffAgainstBaseFiles(repo, "trunk") returns exactly those two paths with kinds M and A.
Given HEAD checked out on trunk itself, diffAgainstBaseFiles(repo, "trunk") returns an empty array.
Given an uncommitted edit on the feature branch, diffAgainstBaseFiles does not list it (three-dot, committed only).
Add the shared diffVsDefaultBranch helper used by both vs-main routes

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-3: create src/lib/checkpoint/vs-default-branch.ts exporting VsDefaultBranchDiff and diffVsDefaultBranch(repoRoot, { projectKey?, filePath? }) which resolves the configured default branch, resolves its base ref, and returns { baseBranch, baseRef, files, diff? } with three-dot semantics; a missing base ref returns baseRef null and files []. Test it against a fixture repo with projects.js mocked.

items.title: Given findProjectByPath returns default_branch "trunk", diffVsDefaultBranch returns baseBranch "trunk", baseRef "trunk", the feature-branch files, and no diff key.
Given filePath "b.txt", the result contains a diff with "+++ b/b.txt".
Given no project config and no main branch in the repo, diffVsDefaultBranch returns baseBranch "main", baseRef null and files [].
Given projectKey "k" whose project sets default_branch "trunk" while findProjectByPath returns null, the result baseBranch is "trunk".
